entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in T.R. Case No.77 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, arising out of Jeypore Mahila P.S.
Case No.17 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/417/313/323/506 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned P.O.,
Special Court under POCSO Act, Jeypore by order dated 26.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the occurrence relates to the year 2021 and the final form has been submitted on 14.09.2022 citing the Petitioner as an absconder.

The Petitioner is stated to have been taken into custody on 18.06.2023.
5.
Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statements of the victim and the medical examination report.

6. It is apt to note, that on perusal of the medical examination report, though charge sheet has been filed under Section 313 of the IPC, but allegation qua the said offence not prima facie made out.
7.
Considering the tenor thereof and the period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
